statements.text: We're saying, 'Look at these technologies. Don't be afraid to explore them.'
statements.venue: Interview on bill to explore AI for border security (Security Info Watch)

statements.text: I’m pleased to see the Biden Administration prioritize integrating advanced technologies like AI—or artificial intelligence—into homeland security initiatives, while still ensuring the protection of civil rights and civil liberties. [...] Our border customs officers – those folks in the blue uniforms – scan vehicles using AI-powered machines to detect and interdict drugs and other dangerous substances before they enter our country.
statements.venue: Opening statement at joint House Homeland Security subcommittee hearing on border technology

statements.text: This bill addresses the capability gaps in border security by requiring the Secretary of Homeland Security to submit a plan to Congress to identify, integrate, and deploy innovating technologies like AI, machine learning, and nanotechnology into our border security initiatives.
statements.venue: Opening statement at joint House Homeland Security subcommittee hearing on border technology

statements.text:
Orange County is full of brilliant young innovators, including the students in Magnolia Science Academy’s CTE program.

Our students are already learning how to leverage robotics and AI. The future is full of new challenges and exciting opportunities-these students are ready! https://t.co/LTsbHAjKqm

I'm proud to announce our district's Congressional App Challenge winners: Rishi Mishra, Theadore Vang, Om Gupta, and Colin Thai!

This all-star team of Oxford Academy juniors created Aries: a desktop app that'll help you browse the web, use AI tools, and more—using your voice. https://t.co/x041jgPd3r

Too many victims of online abuse have gone too long without the legal protections they need when images—deepfake or otherwise—are published without their consent. Too many lives threatened to be ruined, and reputations scorned to be stained. [...] Now, this bipartisan legislation is headed to the President’s desk, and victims will be able to have this material removed from social media platforms and law enforcement have the tools necessary to prosecute the perpetrators of these crimes head-on.
statements.venue: Press release on House vote for TAKE IT DOWN Act (AI deepfakes)

statements.text:
I stopped by the @CongressionalAC showcase last week to see our App Challenge winners present Aries—a desktop app that uses AI to make technology more accessible.

Our students are the future, and this innovative app reflects the talent being raised right here in Orange County.
The Chinese are building a power plant every day. [...] And the big one: about 60% of Main Street China is now implementing AI on a daily basis to increase their productivity.
statements.venue: Interview quoted in John Seiler column (AI race, energy, China)
